title: Classic Bad Omen fixes
description: This is a datapack that reverts the bad omen changes in Version 1.21
body:
This is a Datapack to revert the bad omen changes made in 1.21 I have tried this with multiple raid farms and i always seems to work.This Datapack still allows you to get ominous bottles upon killing the pillager captain and the bad_omen effect.


Do /reload to load the modpack
and /function uninstall:datapack-bad_omen to uninstall the modpack
